That is the encoding answer for burst line 2 (ramped flatDamage at 28.9×12=346.8%, rampSec≈36) and was not stripped by the packet-prep redactor. I did NOT see the driver's override, tests, reasoning, or a truth file — only this schema comment. Flagging so the judge can discount the burst-mirror convergence signal (my ramp assertions are contaminated); every other line was derived from the prose alone. Secondary schema issue (not a leak): the StatKey union as delivered does NOT contain `atkOfMaxHpPct`, yet three of its comments reference that key — the redactor appears to have stripped the member line, so this test filters the S1a ATK grant by /atk/i on the stat name instead of hard-coding a key.

spec.kitLine: enter Burst Stage 3: ATK +2.71% Max HP 10s
spec.assertion: Proves the grant is HP-scaled (stat matches /hp/i, value 2.71), wall-clock 10s (durationSec 10, durationShots undefined), self-scoped, and keyed to stageEnter{stage:3} — plus event-count equality with fullBurstStart (once per rotation). RED under the nearest-wrong burstCast keying (own-cast only, under-fires when helm takes stage 3), under a plain atkPct 2.71 encoding (near-zero on a Defender), and under a durationShots/round reading. CF_ATK_ZERO proves it is load-bearing on her damage while leaving teammate totals byte-identical (self scope).

Proves chargeSpeedPct 100 with removeOnReload:true and NO durationSec, re-applied per shot, terminated by reload — asserted via the reload-cause buffRemove events the engine emits ONLY for removeOnReload buffs. RED under the nearest-wrong invented time window (CF_CS_TIMED: zero buffRemove events). CF_CS_ZERO proves it is DAMAGE, not a defensive skip: shot count and total damage both drop.

spec.kitLine: Full Charge hit: +136.6% of final ATK
spec.assertion: Proves a single 136.6% flatDamage on target enemy with core !== true (the text says 'additional damage', not 'core strike damage'; core:true would over-credit at the 200% core multiplier). CF_RIDER_ZERO proves it contributes; CF_RIDER_NOFB proves it takes the +50% Full Burst major by landing timing (RED under the noFb rider exemption, which is reserved for burst-cast damage).

The entity itself is it.skip'd.

spec.kitLine: stage-3 entry: Decoy avatar 96% Max HP
spec.assertion: A second decoy is unobservable once the first exists (the Beautiful gate only asks 'is a decoy present'), so nothing discriminates one decoy from two. it.skip with that reason.

spec.kitLine: every 3s w/ decoy: Max HP +1.6% x12
spec.assertion: Proves interval{sec:3} + self + value 1.6 + maxStacks 12 + no durationSec ('continuously'), and behaviourally that stacks run 1..12 and never exceed 12. RED under the nearest-wrong uncapped model (~60 stacks over 180s) and under a durationSec'd model (stacks lapse). Cross-line: CF_BEAUTIFUL_ZERO must LOWER her total, proving the self Max HP actually feeds the S1a HP->ATK conversion (whole-picture), while teammates stay byte-identical.

Proves TEN discrete 1365.92% flatDamage effects on burstCast/enemy (RED under a single merged 13659.2% hit — same total, wrong crit/core granularity), and behaviourally that burst-slot damage events are a multiple of 10 per cast and carry fbMajorApplied !== true (burst-cast damage resolves before the FB window opens; RED under an FB-boosted volley).

Asserts flavor:'sequential' on the ten hits so Sequential Attack Damage / sequential multiplier support can feed them. Isolated in its own `it` because a missing flavor is a plausible driver choice — if RED, it is a reportable divergence, not a crash.

Proves the authored magnitude is a whole multiple of 28.9 with k in 1..12 (the Beautiful cap), instance count in {1, 10} (the two defensible once-per-cast vs once-per-hit readings), and that a max-stack-authored magnitude (>=289) carries rampSec in [24,48] — 12 stacks x 3s = 36s to cap, so a flat 12-stack rider over-credits every burst before t=36s. CF_MIRROR_NORAMP must INCREASE total (RED under the no-ramp nearest-wrong); CF_MIRROR_ZERO must decrease it.

fixtures: controlComp('cinderella', true) for all 10 runs (liter B1 / crown B2 / cinderella B3 / helm B3, boss Fire, deterministic, no seed). Helm is deliberately KEPT IN rather than dropped: S1a and S2b both key off 'entering Burst Stage 3', which is a team-wide stage entry, and that reading only diverges from 'her own burst cast' when a SECOND Burst III unit can take the stage-3 slot — with helm=false cinderella is the sole B3 and the two models are degenerate. A lone B3 would also make ZERO Full Bursts, which would void the S1c noFb discriminator. 10 runs total: BASE + 9 counterfactuals (ATK-zero, ATK-retriggered-to-burstCast, chargeSpeed-zero, chargeSpeed-timed, rider-zero, rider-noFb, Beautiful-zero, mirror-zero, mirror-noRamp). Override structure is read from a no-op withPatchedOverride clone (disk untouched) and each patch reports its match count, so a kit line the override never encoded fails as MISSING instead of passing as a silent no-op.
gaps: S2a decoy avatar (96% Max HP, continuous) — it.skip: no avatar entity / HP pool in v1 and the boss deals no damage, so the decoy is damage-inert except as the always-true precondition for the Beautiful interval.
S2b second decoy at stage-3 entry — it.skip: unobservable once a decoy already exists; nothing discriminates one decoy from two.
